```{r}
sps_list = c("Adig", "Ahya", "Amur", "Fspp", "Gfas", "Hcoe", "Pcru", "Pdam", "Plut", "Spin", "Xesp")
thr_pv = 1.1
thr_FC = 0.5
focus_celltype = "gastrodermis_alga_hosting"
mks_list = list()
for(spi in sps_list){
    # set working species
    if (spi == "Spin") {
        spi_w = "Spis"
	} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {
        spi_w = "Hcoe"
    } else {
		spi_w = spi
	}
    #load celltype markers of different species
    mks_genes_fn = sprintf("results_metacell_%s_filt/seu.%s.markers.cts.csv", spi, spi)
    if (! file.exists(mks_genes_fn)) {
        warning(sprintf("File not found for %s: %s", spi, mks_genes_fn))
        next
    }
    mks = read.table(mks_genes_fn, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
    mks$spi = spi_w
    # 移除不需要的列
    cols_to_remove = c("gene_seurat", "orthogroup", "has_TF", 
                        "first_annotation", "first_support", "second_annotation", "second_support")
    mks = mks %>% filter(focus_node == focus_celltype) %>% 
        select(-one_of(cols_to_remove))

    mks_list[[spi]] = mks
    message(sprintf("  %s: %d genes, %d cell types", 
                    spi, 
                    nrow(mks), 
                    length(unique(mks$focus_node))))
}
# 合并所有物种的标记基因
message("\nMerging all species...")
mks_all = do.call(rbind, mks_list)
rownames(mks_all) = NULL
mks_all= mks_all %>%
    filter(avg_log2FC >= thr_FC&p_val_adj <= thr_pv)
message(sprintf("Total:  %d genes across %d species",
                nrow(mks_all), 
                length(unique(mks_all$spi))))
```

```{r}
#---------------------------
# 参数
#---------------------------
sps_order = c("Hcoe", "Xesp", "Pdam", "Spis", "Fspp", "Pcru", "Plut", "Gfas", "Adig", "Amur", "Ahya")
conservation_threshold = 0.4

#---------------------------
# 计算全部物种内的保守 Uniprot_name（保留原始行）
#---------------------------
filter_conserved_uniprot_rows <- function(df, species_vec, thr = 0.7, species_order = NULL) {
  species_vec = unique(species_vec)
  if (!is.null(species_order)) {
    species_vec = species_order[species_order %in% species_vec]
  }

  gene_conservation = df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Uniprot_name) & Uniprot_name != "" & spi %in% species_vec) %>%
    group_by(Uniprot_name) %>%
    summarise(
      n_spi_with_gene = n_distinct(spi),
      species_with_gene = paste(unique(spi), collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      spi_frac_in_group = n_spi_with_gene / length(species_vec),
      is_conserved = spi_frac_in_group >= thr
    )

  if (!is.null(species_order)) {
    gene_conservation = gene_conservation %>%
      mutate(
        species_with_gene = sapply(
          strsplit(species_with_gene, ","),
          function(spis) paste(species_order[species_order %in% spis], collapse = ",")
        )
      )
  }

  df_keep = df %>%
    filter(spi %in% species_vec) %>%
    inner_join(
      gene_conservation %>% filter(is_conserved),
      by = "Uniprot_name"
    )

  list(
    conserved_uniprot = gene_conservation %>% filter(is_conserved) %>% pull(Uniprot_name),
    conserved_rows = df_keep,
    conservation_table = gene_conservation %>% filter(is_conserved)
  )
}

#---------------------------
# 计算全部物种保守 Uniprot_name
#---------------------------
res_all = filter_conserved_uniprot_rows(
  mks_all,
  sps_order,
  conservation_threshold,
  sps_order
)

mks_conserved = res_all$conserved_rows
conserved_uniprot = res_all$conserved_uniprot
conservation_table = res_all$conservation_table

#---------------------------
# 可视化（可选）
#---------------------------
length(conserved_uniprot)

```

```{r}
# 1) 物种排序 & 物种内部基因名排序
mks_conserved_sorted = mks_conserved %>%
  mutate(
    spi = factor(spi, levels = sps_order),
    gene_sort = ifelse(is.na(gene) | gene == "", gene_seurat, gene)
  ) %>%
  arrange(-n_spi_with_gene, Uniprot_name, spi, gene_sort) %>%
  select(-gene_sort)

# 2) 保存结果表
out_dir = "/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/scripts_260424/Integrate_crossspecies_marker"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

write.table(conservation_table,
            file = file.path(out_dir, "algahosing_conserved_uniprot_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.table(mks_conserved_sorted,
            file = file.path(out_dir, "algahosing_conserved_uniprot_rows.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# 3) 统计信息
nrow(conservation_table)
```
